footerDescription: The above festival committee is one of Maharashtra’s prestigious and renowned mandals, inspired by the thoughts of Lokmanya Tilak and actively engaged in public awareness and service since the pre-independence era in 1928. In 1977, it marked a milestone by installing India’s tallest idol, earning global recognition. The mandal is also well known for its grand decorations during Ganeshotsav.
mandalName: Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli-Mumbai Cha Raja
